safety_filters: Skip isolated GTA 6 story cutscenes/endings (copyright strike risk) and skip loud licensed in-game radio songs (Content ID risk).
notes: Starter preset for GTA 6 Whop Content Rewards campaigns. Use 'switch campaign' in chat to swap presets.
